hintLarge: Large: the image takes the full available width.
hintNormal: Normal: the image never exceeds the screen height.
spaceHint: Inner spacing: the distance INSIDE the background and the card, which their colour and wallpaper cover. “Inner top / bottom”: between the edge of the card (or background) and the content; “None” sticks them together; “Top / Bottom” add to this distance. Auto: the theme's spacing. The distance outside is in “Margin”.
marginHint: Outer margin: the distance OUTSIDE the background and the card, where the page shows through (never the wallpaper). Full width: the block takes the whole width; otherwise it is centred, set back from the edges, with its background and card. The space inside is set in “Spacing”.
titleWidth: Outer margin: block width and distance outside the background and the card
titleSpace: Inner spacing: distance inside the background and the card
